about_the_game:
BURN. SURVIVE. CALL THE CROWS 

You are the Caller of the Crows, on a field where there's plenty of food for your crows but guarded by the Scarecrows. Crows are scared of scarecrows. To hijack the field of food for your crows, you must set fire to every single one that haunts and protect the fields from you.

🎮GAME MODES

🔥EVERYTHING BURNS

In Caller of the Crows, fire is your weapon. The corn, the scarecrows, almost everything burns. But be warned: the flames may reveal what hides in the darkness.

👁️ HUNTED BY SCARECROWS

Scarecrows lurk within the corn field, hunting anything that dares disturb them. The more you burn, the more they awaken. These are not lifeless dummies, they watch you. They hunt you. Your only hope? Fire. They won’t stop until the fire consumes them… or you.

🐦‍⬛ CALL THE CROWS

Your crows fear the scarecrows, but once the fields are clear, they will descend to feast. Every scarecrow burned is another step toward victory—but can you burn them all before the nightmare claims you?

🌽NEVER IN THE SAME PLACE

Each area is procedurally generated, leading you deeper into the ever-changing nightmare. No two runs are the same, no escape is guaranteed.

🔥CAN YOU BURN YOUR WAY OUT?

The fields call for fire. The crows' hunger. And the scarecrows… they are waiting.

.

.

-->  CALLER OF THE CROWS  <--
